name.baseName: Steel billets, for beams and angles, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:synonyms: Billette in acciaio per travi e angolari
dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed within the ARCADIA Project (production chain study regarding steel products “STUDIO DI FILIERA ACCIAIO PER COSTRUZIONI IN CARPENTERIA METALLICA”). The dataset involves beams and angles with various profiles produced from scrap from recycling and is representative of the processing technologies commonly used in steel beams and angles production.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Scrucca F., Ceruti F., Sesana M.M., Martelli S.M, Rinaldi, C., 2023. “STUDIO DI FILIERA CCIAIO PER COSTRUZIONI IN CARPENTERIA METALLICA”. Internal report ARCADIA Project. For the LCA study background datasets from Ecoinvent database cut-off (v. 3.7.1) were used.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Italy. Primary data collected in Lombardia e Piemonte. Dataset representative of Italian production of billets for steel beams and angles.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: 1 kg of steel, in billets, for beams and angles, available for all subsequent transport/processing operations. Steel is produced from recycled scrap through the Electric Arc Furnace (EAF) process. Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system. Primary data were collected as physical quantities of materials used in the different processes. Background data were modelled according to Ecoinvent v. 3.7.1
technology.technologicalApplicability: Steel billets for the production of beams and angles with various profiles, produced from scrap from recycling. Commercial steel grade from S235 to S355, according to EN 10025.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructure are not included, except for the background system.

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. Each dataset has been evaluated based on the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representativeness; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographical Representativeness; 4. Reliability. In this contest the Reliability is “good”.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology.
